candidate_relations.label: Breast Cancer Recurrence, left breast
candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis is leiomyosarcoma, a radiation-induced or de novo soft-tissue sarcoma arising in the retromammary space/pectoralis region. The core-needle biopsy showed only atrophic mammary glands (no carcinoma), the mass is fixed to pectoralis major, and the clinical context (prior radiation, retromammary location, rapid growth, biopsy negative for carcinoma) points to a sarcoma rather than recurrent breast carcinoma. Breast cancer recurrence is a different diagnostic entity.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Breast cancer recurrence is a distinct diagnostic entity from leiomyosarcoma; the reference diagnosis is a primary sarcoma, not a recurrent carcinoma

case_quality_flags: Radiation-induced sarcoma context: prior 50 Gy to left breast 6 years earlier strongly supports post-irradiation leiomyosarcoma
Core-needle biopsy showing only atrophic mammary glands argues against carcinoma recurrence and supports mesenchymal origin
